remediation.analysis: The /hello route reflects req.query.name directly into an HTML response via string concatenation, enabling reflected XSS (CWE-79). The prior fix attempted escaping but used a regex that grouped multiple characters per match, causing lookup failures and output corruption ("undefined"). The remediation must properly escape each special character without altering the intended displayed text semantics.
remediation.remediation_strategy: Apply correct HTML escaping to untrusted input before inserting it into the HTML response. Use a character-by-character replacement with a mapping function so adjacent special characters are handled correctly, preserving the visible output while preventing HTML/JS injection.
